description: Source code for Node.js internal CommonJS module loader, including functions for module resolution, package reading, and error handling.

methods.name: stat
methods.description: Checks the status of a filename, utilizing a cache for efficiency.

methods.name: readPackage
methods.description: Reads and caches package.json data for a given path.

methods.name: readPackageScope
methods.description: Traverses parent directories to find package.json data.

methods.name: createCjsLoader
methods.description: Creates a CommonJS module loader with custom resolution logic.

methods.name: tryPackage
methods.description: Attempts to resolve a package's main file based on package.json.

methods.name: tryFile
methods.description: Checks if a file exists and resolves symlinks based on options.

methods.name: toRealPath
methods.description: Resolves a real filesystem path for a given filename.

methods.name: statReplacementExtensions
methods.description: Checks for file existence with various extension replacements.

methods.name: tryReplacementExtensions
methods.description: Attempts to find a file with alternative extensions.

methods.name: tryExtensions
methods.description: Checks if a path exists with any of the provided extensions.

methods.name: trySelfParentPath
methods.description: Determines the parent path for self-resolution.

methods.name: trySelf
methods.description: Attempts to resolve module self-reference based on package exports.

methods.name: resolveExports
methods.description: Resolves package exports for scoped or unscoped modules.

methods.name: finalizeEsmResolution
methods.description: Finalizes ESM resolution, converting URLs to paths.

methods.name: createEsmNotFoundErr
methods.description: Creates an error for unresolved ESM modules.

methods.name: Module_findPath
methods.description: Finds the path to a module, considering extensions and symlinks.

methods.name: Module_resolveFilename
methods.description: Resolves a module filename, handling various resolution cases.

methods.name: assertScriptCanLoadAsCJS
methods.description: Checks if a script can be loaded as CommonJS, throwing if it should be ESM.
